## Project Overview

### 0. Configure environment. Load data.
```{r config, show=F, warning=F, message=F}

source(here::here("analysis/0-config.R"))

############################
# File 01B data
############################
df_all <- readRDS(paste0(final_data_path,"df_01B_all.rds"))
df_mal <- readRDS(paste0(final_data_path,"df_01B_mal.rds"))
df_pne <- readRDS(paste0(final_data_path,"df_01B_pne.rds"))
df_dia <- readRDS(paste0(final_data_path,"df_01B_dia.rds"))

colnames(df_all)

```

### Create regression models.

* RQ 3.1: Do effects of political unrest and terrorism on treatment-seeking differ by disorder type?
* RQ 3.2: Do effects of political unrest and terrorism on treatment seeking patterns differ by intensity?

```{r reg-run, warning=F, message=F, include=F}
#################################
# Create negative binomial
# regression models across diff
# exposure variables.
# (See 0-functions-analysis.R
# for helper function details.)
#################################
m1_all_any <- negbin_helper(df_all, "event_any")

# 3ry analysis: Stratified analyses by disorder type (added in R&R)
m3_all_any_pol <- negbin_helper(df_all, "event_any_pol")
m3_all_any_dem <- negbin_helper(df_all, "event_any_dem")
m3_all_any_str <- negbin_helper(df_all, "event_any_str")

# 3ry analysis: Stratified analyses by event intensity (added in R&R)
m3_all_any_vio <- negbin_helper(df_all, "event_any_vio")

## glimpse of results
summary(m3_all_any_vio)
exp(summary(m3_all_any_vio)$coeff) #exponentiate to get IRR

```

### 2A. Format results table. Download. (Intensity; non-/violent)
```{r create-table}

table_3ry_viol_html <- 
  
  tab_model(
       m3_all_any_vio,
       
       show.loglik=T,
       string.est = "IRR",
       string.ci = "95% CI",
       
       pred.labels = c("Intercept",
                       "Political unrest & terrorism (0/1)",
                       "Ramadan (0/1)",
                       "Rainfall (mm)"
                       ),
       
       dv.labels = c("Intensity (Non-/violent)") )

table_3ry_viol_html

tab_model(
   m3_all_any_vio,
   
   show.loglik=T,
   string.est = "IRR",
   string.ci = "95% CI",
   
   pred.labels = c("Intercept",
                   "Political unrest & terrorism (0/1)",
                   "Ramadan (0/1)",
                   "Rainfall (mm)"
                   ),
   
   dv.labels = c("Intensity (Non-/violent)"),
   
   file = paste0(table_path,"table-5-3ry-viol-results.doc") )

```
